findings.title: Plan documents are committed as empty scaffolds
findings.why: The four plan files (1-2 to 1-5) contain only the frontmatter and the placeholder comment, even though their own comment says to replace it. They have status `active` and no plan content, so they document nothing.

findings.title: Double blank line before `has`
findings.why: Two consecutive blank lines separate `resolvePointer` and the `has` helper. The rest of the file uses one.
